title.zh: 【英国央行启动有关中央清算对手方接受合格抵押品代币化形式的咨询】
title.en: 【英国央行启动有关中央清算对手方接受合格抵押品代币化形式的咨询】

current_state.zh: The Bank of England launched a consultation on how central counterparties can accept tokenized forms of eligible collateral, stating the existing regime already permits it if valuation, transfer and liquidation standards are met, and will issue a supervisory statement setting out how it assesses such applications.
current_state.en: The Bank of England launched a consultation on how central counterparties can accept tokenized forms of eligible collateral, stating the existing regime already permits it if valuation, transfer and liquidation standards are met, and will issue a supervisory statement setting out how it assesses such applications.
